what: Chemed owns two unrelated businesses. VITAS Healthcare is one of the largest hospice providers in the United States, caring for terminally ill patients at home and in dedicated units. Roto-Rooter is a plumbing and drain-cleaning service brand.
customers: VITAS serves patients at the end of life, with the bill paid almost entirely by Medicare. Roto-Rooter serves homeowners with blocked drains and burst pipes, plus commercial property managers.
money: Hospice care reimbursed per patient day by Medicare and Medicaid.
Drain cleaning, plumbing repair and water damage restoration, through company branches and franchisees.
moat: VITAS has scale in hospice markets where referral relationships with hospitals and nursing homes take years to build, and hospice licences are regulated. Roto-Rooter is the name people recall when a drain blocks, backed by national advertising and a fleet that can arrive the same day.
risks: Nearly all VITAS revenue comes from Medicare, so a change in the hospice payment rate changes profit directly.
Hospice is subject to payment caps and to audits, and billing disputes can produce large one-off charges.
Roto-Rooter's residential call volume has been soft; homeowners defer non-urgent plumbing work when budgets tighten.
Nursing staff shortages raise VITAS labour costs and limit how many patients it can admit.
The shares trade at about 26 times earnings, a premium that assumes steady growth from both halves.
opportunities: Hospice demand rises mechanically with the ageing of the population, independent of the economy.
Revenue has grown each year shown, from $2.1B in 2021 to $2.5B in 2025.
The balance sheet is nearly debt-free: $143.8M of debt against $74.5M of cash, unusual for a healthcare provider.
Free cash flow of roughly $295.5M funds continuous share buybacks, which have shrunk the share count for years.
watch: VITAS admissions and average daily census. Hospice is paid per patient day, so the census is the revenue driver, and it shows whether referral relationships and staffing are both working.
